hero.title: Manage your firm
hero.description: Centralize clients, cases, documents and calendar in a single platform built for lawyers who seek efficiency and organization.
hero.disclaimer: No credit card required. Set up in minutes.

features.sectionDescription: Tools designed to simplify legal management and boost your team's productivity.

clients.title: Client Management
clients.description: Register and organize all your clients in one place. Easily access history, documents and linked cases.

processes.title: Case Control
processes.description: Track every stage of legal cases with real-time status and full movement history.

calendar.title: Smart Calendar
calendar.description: Manage appointments, hearings and deadlines with automatic notifications so you never miss an important date.

documents.title: Document Management
documents.description: Store and organize contracts, petitions and documents securely, with quick access at any time.

reports.title: Reports & Metrics
reports.description: Visualize your firm's performance with charts and indicators to make strategic decisions based on data.

security.title: Advanced Security
security.description: Your data protected with end-to-end encryption and role-based access control.

steps.sectionDescription: In three simple steps, you are already managing your firm efficiently.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.description: Sign up for free in minutes. Just provide your details and configure your firm's profile.

step2.title: Configure and customize
step2.description: Add your clients, configure case workflows and adapt the system to your firm's reality.

step3.title: Start managing
step3.description: With everything set up, manage clients, cases, documents and calendar in a centralized, intuitive dashboard.

testimonials.sectionDescription: Lawyers across Brazil already trust LawManagement to organize their firms.
testimonials.rodrigo: LawManagement completely transformed my firm's routine. I used to rely on spreadsheets and wasted so much time looking for information. Now everything is centralized and my productivity has tripled.
testimonials.fernanda: The case management is simply incredible. I can track every detail, receive deadline alerts and have never missed a hearing since. I recommend it to all my OAB colleagues.
testimonials.marcelo: I handle over 80 clients and the system handles it all effortlessly. The documents section is the standout feature — everything organized and accessible from anywhere, even on my phone.
testimonials.camila: The support is excellent and the platform is very easy to use. Within less than a week I was using it with full confidence. Highly recommended for lawyers looking to modernize their practice.

banner.description: Join hundreds of lawyers who already save hours each week with LawManagement.

description.content: LawManagement is a legal management platform offering tools for organizing clients, cases, documents and schedules. The service is provided as software as a service (SaaS) and can be accessed via a web browser. We reserve the right to modify, suspend or discontinue any part of the service at any time, with prior notice where possible.

registration.content: To use LawManagement, you must create an account by providing accurate and complete information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all activities carried out under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. We reserve the right to terminate accounts that violate these terms.

It is expressly prohibited to: use the service for fraudulent or illegal purposes; transmit third-party data without authorization; attempt to gain unauthorized access to systems or networks; use the platform in a way that could damage, overload or compromise the service infrastructure.

Data entered by users remains the property of those users. By using the platform, you grant us a limited license to process and store that data as necessary to provide the service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use LawManagement.

collect.title: 1. Information We Collect
collect.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as name, email address and password at registration. We also collect data entered during platform use, such as client information, cases and documents. Usage data such as IP address, browser type and pages visited are collected automatically for security and service improvement purposes.

use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
use.content: We use your information to: provide, operate and improve the service; authenticate your identity and protect your account; send service-related notifications; respond to support requests; comply with legal obligations. We do not use your data for marketing purposes without your express consent.

storage.title: 3. Storage and Security
storage.content: Your data is stored on secure servers with encryption at rest and in transit. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction. We retain your data for as long as necessary to provide the service or as required by law.

sharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties for commercial purposes. We may share data with service providers who assist us in operating the platform, always under confidentiality agreements. We may disclose information when required by law or to protect rights, property or safety.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to: access your personal data; correct incomplete or inaccurate data; request deletion of your data; withdraw consent for data processing; request portability of your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at nicolasbezerra13@gmail.com.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.content: We use essential cookies to maintain your authenticated session and ensure the platform functions correctly. We do not use tracking cookies for advertising. You can configure your browser to refuse cookies, but this may affect the functionality of some platform features.

changes.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through a notice on the platform. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.content: For questions about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, contact us at: nicolasbezerra13@gmail.com. We will respond within 5 business days.
